verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents an official `pplx` CLI that returns structured JSON from the Search API, aimed at shell pipelines, interactive terminal work, and coding agents. It also supports query-relevant page extraction, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page is live. Missing for 10: any independent or hands-on corroboration; evidence that the CLI covers more than the Search API (e.g., Agent API or Computer tasks); install, auth, and command-depth details.
